issues.description: The problem statement requires initializing the ArrayList of animals in a no-argument Farm constructor and the provided Main uses new Farm() accordingly, but the solution's Farm only defines Farm(int initialCapacity). This mismatch means the expected no-arg constructor is missing in the solution and the sample Main (and students' expected implementation) will not compile against the solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a no-argument constructor in Farm that initializes animals = new ArrayList<>() (e.g. public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); }). Optionally keep the existing Farm(int initialCapacity) as an overloaded constructor. Update any usage or documentation consistently so Main and the problem instructions align with the available constructors.
